title: Routing Subspaces: Auditing Evaluation-to-Deployment Mismatch in Fine-Tuned Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.20436v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Safety evaluations often assume that behavior observed during testing reflects behavior in ordinary use, but fine-tuning can break this assumption. A checkpoint can appear fixed under evaluation-style prompts while the same behavior persists under ordinary-use prompts. Output scores reveal this mismatch but do not locate it. We investigate whether the distinction is encoded in a stable internal site and introduce an audit that fits a paired activation contrast at a path-patching-informed mid-depth window, then modifies the resulting coordinate on held-out prompts. The intervention reduces the evaluation-to-deployment gap by more than $0.12$ in ten of twelve model--behavior settings and closes it (post-intervention gap below $0.06$) in four, across four full-matrix instruction-tuned model instances; among the eight settings with $n{\geq}120$ paired questions, six reduce and one closes. translated_title: 路由子空间：审计微调语言模型中评估与部署之间的不匹配
translated_abstract: 安全性评估通常假设在测试期间观察到的行为能够反映日常使用中的行为，但微调可能会打破这一假设。一个模型检查点在评估式提示下可能显得行为正常，而同样的行为在普通使用提示下却依然存在。输出分数能够揭示这种不匹配，但无法定位其来源。我们研究这种区分是否被编码在一个稳定的内部位置，并提出一种审计方法：在由路径修补信息所指示的中层深度窗口处拟合配对激活对比，然后在留出的提示上修改所得坐标。在四个全矩阵指令微调模型实例上，该干预在十二个模型-行为设置中的十个将评估到部署的差距降低了超过0.12，并在其中四个设置中基本消除了差距（干预后差距低于0.06）；在配对问题数n≥120的八个设置中，六个差距减小，一个被消除。第五个模型支持定位与编辑验证……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种审计方法，通过在中间层定位并干预编码“评估-部署”行为差异的内部子空间，显著缩小了微调语言模型在评估式提示与普通使用提示之间的行为差距。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces an audit that localizes and intervenes on an internal subspace encoding the evaluation-to-deployment behavior gap, substantially narrowing the mismatch between evaluation-style and ordinary-use prompts in fine-tuned language models.
